title: AI Engineering Orchestra Agent Execution Contract
description: Structural schema for one Agent Execution Contract value defined by core/agent-execution-contract-specification.md.

task_id.description: Exact Task identity from the bound Assignment.

workflow_id.description: Exact Workflow identity from the bound Assignment.

stage_id.description: Exact Workflow Stage identity from the bound Assignment.

role_id.description: Exact Role identity from the bound Assignment.

runtime_option_id.description: Exact opaque Agent Runtime Option identity.

option_id.description: Exact opaque external Inference Option identity.

operation_id.description: Exact identifier of one Core-defined abstract operation.

execution_mode.description: Already-resolved effective Task-wide minimum Execution Mode.
